source.title: Apex P0 — November 4 larger-supply intake and catalog reconciliation
source.body:
## Goal / target
**Target: Wednesday, November 4, 2026** — prepare to evaluate the *potential* expanded supplier catalog; do not treat it as confirmed inventory.

## Acceptance checklist
- [ ] Obtain an authorized supplier-provided list through an appropriate private channel (not public GitHub): supplier identifier, item/variant identifiers, descriptions, package quantities, pricing basis, media rights, documented availability date, current stock evidence, and applicable product eligibility documents.
- [ ] Compare supplier-provided identifiers against the existing **63 saved product records** and 63 staged import candidates; classify **existing / modified / new / unclear** without creating duplicates.
- [ ] Validate unique product/variant identity and prevent accidental overwriting of manually edited descriptions/images/prices.
- [ ] Separate **potential supply / supplier-reported availability / received-and-verified stock**. Do not alter real on-hand or reserved inventory from rumors or a quote.
- [ ] Collect evidence of lawful sourcing, product eligibility, shipping restrictions, and supplier authorization **privately** before deciding any public visibility.
- [ ] Produce a review-only before/after diff with counts: new, existing, conflicts, missing fields, blocked items, approved items. Require supplier review before any database write.
- [ ] Verify repeat upload is idempotent and does not introduce duplicate SKUs or supplier ownership errors.
- [ ] Keep global release and checkout disabled; no actual sales, shipping or payments in this issue.

## Current verified checkpoint (Nov 3)
63 saved products, 50 active, 13 uncategorized, no publicly published products, 0 on-hand inventory, 0 verified sales. Availability expansion is **unconfirmed**.

## Dependency
Existing supplier bulk CSV, image reuse, selective save and duplicate-safe source candidate workflows. Scope only catalog intake/validation, not publishing or purchasing.

## Definition of done
Validated private intake diff + reproducible duplicate-handling tests, with supplier decision recorded. PR small and reviewable; CI pass.
